content.title: DuPont Spinoff Qnity Started Trading Today. What to Know.
content.summary: A company spun out by DuPont,  Qnity Electronics  started trading on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol “Q” on Monday.  Qnity describes itself as “one of the largest global leaders in materials and solutions for the semiconductor and electronics industries,” with some 10,000 employees worldwide.  The company provides chemicals and materials used to manufacture semiconductors and circuit boards.
